text: Lucy won’t marry him. If you’d gone on about her, as you did about them, he might have broken down.” “But when—” “Late last night. I must go.” “Perhaps they won’t want me down there.” “No—go on. Good-bye.” “Thank goodness!” exclaimed Mr. Beebe to himself, and struck the saddle of his bicycle approvingly, “It was the one foolish thing she ever did. Oh, what a glorious riddance!” And, after a little thought, he negotiated the slope into Windy Corner, light of heart.
